name: Linden Special Needs Day Camp
operator_name: City of Linden Department of Parks and Recreation
description_short: Seven week city day camp for Linden children with special needs entering kindergarten through grade 6, held at McGillvray Park in the 8th Ward with weekly arts and crafts, visiting guests, optional trips and an end of summer talent show. Only Linden residents can register.
special_needs_notes: Camp for children with special needs. An IEP must be submitted at registration and campers must be toilet trained; acceptance depends on whether the program can meet the camper's needs and on space.
notes: Linden residents only (proof of residency required). Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm. Three packages for the 7 weeks: Standard $500 (no trips; trips can be bought one at a time), Silver $705 (5 trips, no trip lunch), Gold $755 (5 trips with lunch on trips). Trips are optional and camp is closed on trip days for campers not attending. Rain site: 8th Ward Park Recreation Building. Registration deadline May 15, 2026.
